faqs.question: What kinds of projects do you take on?
faqs.shortAnswer: Custom software, AWS infrastructure and DevOps, plus the operations that follow.
faqs.answer: Typical work includes business applications and SaaS platforms, backend systems and APIs, AWS environments, CI/CD and production support. For businesses in India we also build websites, Shopify and WordPress stores.

faqs.question: Can you take over an existing production system?
faqs.shortAnswer: Yes. We start by understanding it before changing anything.
faqs.answer: We review the code, infrastructure, deployments and monitoring, document what we find, and agree priorities with you. Then we stabilise, improve and take on day-to-day operations.

faqs.question: Do you work with international clients?
faqs.shortAnswer: Our client work so far has been in India, and we’re now opening to U.S. and international teams.
faqs.answer: We’ve built and operate production systems for businesses in India, including a commerce platform engineered for 5,000+ concurrent users on AWS. We’re now taking on projects and agency partnerships with U.S. and international companies, often starting with a small, well-scoped pilot.

faqs.question: How do you communicate across time zones?
faqs.shortAnswer: Agreed overlap hours, written updates and regular demos.
faqs.answer: We agree communication channels and overlapping hours at the start. Written progress updates and demos of working software mean progress never waits on a meeting, and you can always talk to the engineers directly.

faqs.question: What happens after launch?
faqs.shortAnswer: We stay responsible for keeping it running.
faqs.answer: We can run the production system for you: monitoring and alerts, backups, security updates, incident response and planned improvements, on a retainer that fits your needs.

projects.title: Production Commerce Platform
projects.summary: A commerce platform we help build and operate on AWS, engineered for 5,000+ concurrent users.
projects.description: We work on the application and backend, and run the AWS production infrastructure behind it: load-balanced, auto-scaling EC2 capacity, a managed relational database, automated deployments, and monitoring and backups.

caseStudies.title: Production Commerce Platform
caseStudies.headline: Engineered for 5,000+ concurrent users
caseStudies.summary: We build and operate a production commerce platform on AWS: the application and backend, the infrastructure it runs on, and the day-to-day operations that keep it available.
caseStudies.challenge: Serve 5,000+ concurrent users reliably, absorb changes in traffic without manual intervention, and ship improvements safely while the business keeps trading.
caseStudies.solution: Application servers run on multiple EC2 instances in an Auto Scaling Group behind an Application Load Balancer, so capacity follows demand. The application and API use a managed relational database. A CI/CD pipeline handles deployments, and monitoring and automated backups support day-to-day operations.
caseStudies.outcome: The platform runs in production, with our team responsible for ongoing engineering and operations.
